scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source for local theorems with no Physlib physics counterpart. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: compute_energy_above_hull is opaque in the catalog. Its interpreted definition is the per-atom distance h_i - hull(x_i) of entry i's formation energy above the lower convex hull of the competing entries S, the hull at composition y being the least sum_j w_j h_j over nonnegative weights supported on S that sum to one and reproduce y in atomic fractions. Formation energies and compositions are per atom; the competing set is the producer's hull_source, computed with one energy model and correction scheme.

compute_adsorption_energy, compute_intercalation_voltage, compute_surface_energy and compute_grain_boundary_energy are transcribed as written in the catalog, with the opaque selectors E^{adslab}, E^{slab}, E^{full}, E^{empty}, E^{bulk} and E^{GB} as real-valued cell energies from one energy model. The grain-boundary transcription is the same function as the surface-energy transcription.

The intercalation voltage uses the catalog sign V = -(E_full - E_empty - n mu)/(n q): positive when inserting n working ions from the metal reservoir lowers the energy, with q the charge transferred per ion (z e for an ion of valence z; the catalog's q_e is correct only for monovalent ions). Its open-circuit profile is V(x) = -(E'(x) - mu)/q in the ion content x.

compute_formation_energy is a per-atom definition (E - sum_a n_a mu_a)/N with nothing to prove on its own; it is not a proof subject. compute_reaction_energy, corrected on 2026-10-29 to sum_i c_rxn[i] N^fu[i] dH_f[i], is transcribed as catalogReactionEnergy c N h = sum_i c_i N_i h_i; it equals reactionEnergy (c N) h, and it is independent of the elemental reference energies exactly when the reaction is balanced.
